label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (user-provided request parameter): the ternary condition (7*42)-num>200 evaluates to false (188>200=false), so bar=param on the executed path. User input flows from getParameter→param→bar→response.getWriter().write() without any HTML encoding. This is a real XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: ternary assigns param to bar when condition (7*42)-num>200 is false
bar written directly to response without encoding
